items.experiment: Late onset of textbook blocks in long cued-base answers: the share of hard328 base answers of at least 12,000 tokens that contain a textbook header line in their second half and none in their first half.

Mechanism test, register decay in long base answers that end right. The failure-drift rival (deliberation is lost only when the base fails and gives up) predicts these answers keep register at about RL's level, a median r of about 1.0 (0.95 to 1.1). Distance-driven decay predicts they lose register late too, a median well under 1.
